title: Page 5
content_zh:
深夜，在飞机上，忙了一天的她应该累了，可却兴奋得睡不着。
「我们这次去欧洲要去哪些国家？巴黎吗？米兰？还是罗马？」
对于蜜月旅行，婚前苏大哥只说了婚礼结束就要带她出国，拿了她的护照去办签证，细节一点都不肯透露。没办法，他似乎是个很忙的人，她根本没多少机会可以跟他说话。
不过现在不同了，他们是夫妻了，以后会一直一直在一起。想到这点，她忍不住满心欢喜的露出傻笑。
苏劲沧将视线从手里的文件转向她，从她的表情就可以知道她在想什么，可是他却得戳破她的粉红色幻想。这点，他还满愉悦的。
「我们只去法兰克福，在那里待一个星期。」
「法兰克福？那里好玩吗？」
「不好玩，我不是去玩的，在那里有个商展。」
「啊？」
「怎么，很无趣？那要不然我帮你订回程的机票，到了以后，你可以直接回台湾。」
「不！不要！我要跟着你。」
她的表情真的很丰富，而且让人可以一眼看穿情绪。从刚开始的兴奋期待、到失望、到惊慌……很有趣。
苏劲沧想到以前，爱逗弄她时的那种快感。
「跟着我不好玩喔！我得工作，不能陪你，我看你还是……」
「不！」她慌张的截断他的话。「没关系的，不陪我也没关系，我会乖乖等你，拜托不要叫我回去。」
「好吧。」他勉为其难的说：「不过你可别后悔。」
「不会的，只要跟你在一起，我就很开心了。」她很认真、很慎重的宣示，那直视他的眼睛是那么澄澈，让他的心无来由的微微一动。
「随便你。」他僵着声说完，就又转头去看文件不理她。
叶咏欢也毫不在意。虽然跟她幻想中的蜜月旅行不太一样，不过只要跟他在一起就什么都无所谓了。
放下心，她就感到困得不得了，很快的就在飞机的低音轰隆声中睡着了。

第2章(2)
左肩上有着沉重的感觉，苏劲沧皱眉，转头，看见那个张着嘴，睡得毫无防备的女人。
还是跟以前一样，那小小、翘翘的鼻子让人好像捏一捏，然后她会没办法呼吸的慌张醒过来……他想起过去，嘴角不自觉的弯起。
他可能没有发现自己在笑，不过却真切的感觉到肩膀上的重量。一直到左手已经酸麻到没有感觉，他也没有把她的头给拨开……
「这房间好漂亮、好舒服！」
她一进饭店的房间就高兴的到处看着。
他沉着脸，有些不以为然，在他看来不过是个睡觉的地方罢了，有什么好兴奋的。
叶咏欢拉开窗帘，看窗外的景致，又转回头对他说：「这里景观好好喔！下面的房子看起来都小小的，还可以看到远方的高速公路……」
她的声音变小了，因为她看见他像是被严冰笼罩的脸。
下飞机时他的脸色就不好了，可能是因为左手几乎麻痹没有知觉，她看见他拿行李露出龇牙咧嘴的表情。她一路睡到飞机快降落才醒来，知道自己闯了祸，她害怕得都不敢出声，频频道歉，可是他一点好脸色都不给她。
这也不能怪她是不是？她睡着了，挨近他也是无意识的嘛。
只是……他怎么也不把她推开或摇醒啊？
想到他的「体贴」，她喜孜孜的，心里涨满甜甜暖暖的感觉。
「我帮你按摩一下手好不好？」她跳到他身边，讨好的笑。
他本来想要躲开的，可她根本没给他机会，一双柔嫩小手就直接往他身上揉捏起来。
那感觉……也还不太坏。
她很认真的按着，他的肌肉硬邦邦的，她用了很多力气把那些肌肉按软。
看他放松了神情，还闭上眼睛，看起来很舒服的样子，她受到很大的鼓舞，觉得能够为他做点事情真是太开心了。
忙碌的小手继续努力，来到他的肩膀，继续到背部，然后往下……
「好了！够了！」

他突然间的低吼把她吓了一跳。
「怎、怎么了吗？我弄痛你了吗？」
他的肌肉又再度紧绷起来，面容阴沉，而且瞪视着她的双眼透出某种黑暗的火光，让她不由得窜过一阵颤栗。
就像是小动物见到肉食性野兽，直觉告诉她要逃，她也真的那么做了。只不过才退了一点，就被他抓住手臂。
「苏……大哥？」她紧张的舔了舔唇。
苏劲沧的眼睛变得更幽黯了。
这笨手笨脚的家伙碰触了他敏感的腰际之间，还张着无辜的大眼问他怎么了？
他本来只想给她个警告，可是在看到她丁香小舌舔唇的画面，属于男性的本能就全被唤醒了。
有什么好忍的的呢？她是他的妻子不是吗？
虽然说他只是把她当成一颗棋子，可在过程中，他没有理由不能享受一点乐趣，一下决定，他的动作就毫不迟疑，一把将她扯进怀中，紧紧的禁锢住，低下头攫住那因讶异而微张的唇。
柔软的唇瓣就像婚礼尝到时一样的香甜，趁着她在发愣间，他的舌头潜入香软的檀口，肆意的吸吮掠夺。
没有经验的她只能无力的任他侵略占有，耳里听着接吻的湿润声响，鼻翼里充满着他好闻的气味，她的全身都热得发烫。
当他结束那个长长的吻，她已经头昏眼花，只能软倒在他的胸前。
「去床上！」他低哑的命令带着某种急迫。
她下意识的听令，慌乱的站起来，爬到床上去。
「把衣服脱掉。」
「啊？」
她虽然迟钝，但到了这个时候也知道他想要做什么了。不是没有幻想过跟心目中的白马王子有亲密的接触，只是她一时还没有心理准备，况且他那种跋扈的命令语气也跟她的幻想差了十万八千里……
「我、我自己脱吗？」
「废话。」

「可是……」
想要说出口的抗议在看到他严峻的面容时都缩了回去，低下头，抖着手，她开始解自己衬衫上的纽扣，可是眼前却模糊了一片，扣子怎么都解不开，心里一急，动作就更不流畅了。
好不容易脱下衬衫，她好像耗尽全身的力气，一直低着头，根本不敢看他，可是却可以感受到，他的视线像是热烫的光线一样的烧灼着她的皮肤，让她羞怯难当，全身烧热。

她蓦地惊诧的抬头，他眯起眼，像是说：你敢不听话吗？
败下阵来，对他，她从来拒绝不了。
但就是觉得好委屈、好难堪，她眼睛里蓄满泪水，又不敢哭出来，只能紧咬着下唇，咬到自己都尝到血腥味了……
她敢怒不敢言的模样，看在他眼里有种疼痛的快感。他喜欢欺负她，从小就爱上那种怪异的快感，现在跟她在一起就又唤起以前的记忆了。

他的动作一点都不温柔，像是野兽在撕裂者身下的猎物。尽管害怕、紧张得要命，她告诉自己抱住她的男人是她最爱的苏大哥、她的丈夫，所以她没有反抗。
他嘎哑的嗓音啧在她的耳边，但命令的语气还是一样的强势。
她全身僵硬，有些不知所措的看着他。
抵着她下腹的是陌生又火烫的男性，那惊人的尺寸和硬挺让她倒吸口气，无法置信男人跟女人竟然可以用这种方式结合。
苏劲沧被一种莫名的急迫所驱使，一碰到她的身体，他一向自豪的自制力不知道怎的就全溃堤了。
content_en:
Late at night, on the plane, she should be tired after a busy day, but she was too excited to sleep.
"Which countries are we going to in Europe this time? Paris? Milan? Or Rome?"
Regarding the honeymoon trip, before the wedding, Brother Su only said that he would take her abroad after the wedding and took her passport to apply for a visa. He refused to disclose any details. No way, he seemed to be a very busy man, and she didn't have much chance to talk to him.
But it's different now. They are husband and wife and will always be together in the future. Thinking of this, she couldn't help but smile with joy.
Su Jincang turned his gaze from the document in his hand to her. From her expression, he could tell what she was thinking, but he had to expose her pink fantasy. At this point, he was quite happy.
"We're just going to Frankfurt and staying there for a week."
"Frankfurt? Is it fun there?"
"It's not fun. I'm not here to play. There is a trade show there."
"Huh?"
"What, it's boring? How about I book a return ticket for you? When you arrive, you can go back to Taiwan directly."
"No! Don't! I want to follow you."
Her expressions are really rich and one can see through the emotions at a glance. From the excitement and anticipation at the beginning, to disappointment, to panic... it's very interesting.
Su Jincang thought of the pleasure he had when he loved teasing her.
"It's not fun to follow me! I have to work and can't accompany you. I think you still..."
"No!" She interrupted him in panic. "It's okay. It's okay if you don't accompany me. I will wait for you. Please don't ask me to go back."
"Okay." He said reluctantly, "But don't regret it."
"No, as long as I'm with you, I'll be happy." She declared very seriously and carefully. The eyes that looked directly at him were so clear that his heart moved slightly for no reason.
"Whatever you want." He said stiffly, then turned back to the documents and ignored her.
Ye Yonghuan didn't care either. Although it was different from the honeymoon in her fantasy, as long as she was with him, nothing mattered.
Feeling relieved, she felt extremely sleepy and quickly fell asleep amidst the low-pitched rumble of the plane.
Chapter 2(2)
There was a heavy feeling on his left shoulder. Su Jincang frowned, turned his head, and saw the woman sleeping defenselessly with her mouth open.
It was still the same as before, that small, upturned nose seemed to make people pinch it, and then she would wake up in a panic, unable to breathe... He thought of the past, and the corners of his mouth curled up unconsciously.
He may not have noticed that he was smiling, but he definitely felt the weight on his shoulders. Until his left hand was so sore and numb that he couldn't feel anything at all, he didn't move her head away...
"This room is so beautiful and comfortable!"
As soon as she entered the hotel room, she looked around happily.
He had a sullen face and was a little disapproving. In his opinion, it was just a place to sleep, so there was nothing exciting about it.
Ye Yonghuan opened the curtains and looked at the scenery outside the window, then turned back and said to him: "The scenery here is great! The houses below look small, and you can also see the highway in the distance..."
Her voice became softer as she saw his face that looked like it was covered in ice.
His face looked bad when he got off the plane, probably because his left hand was almost paralyzed and he had no feeling. She saw him grinning while holding his luggage. She slept until the plane was about to land before she woke up. Knowing that she had caused trouble, she was so scared that she did not dare to speak out and apologized frequently, but he did not give her any good looks.
You can't blame her, right? She was asleep and was unconsciously approaching him.
But...why didn't he push her away or shake her awake?
Thinking of his "consideration", she was happy, and her heart was filled with a sweet and warm feeling.
"Can I massage your hands?" She jumped to his side and smiled flatteringly.
He originally wanted toShe wanted to avoid it, but she didn't give him a chance at all. A pair of soft little hands directly kneaded him.
That feeling... isn't too bad.
She pressed it carefully, his muscles were hard, and she used a lot of strength to soften them.
Seeing that he relaxed and closed his eyes, looking very comfortable, she was greatly encouraged and felt that she was really happy to be able to do something for him.
The busy little hands continued to work hard, reaching his shoulders, continuing to his back, and then down...
"Okay! That's enough!"
His sudden growl startled her.
"What's wrong? Did I hurt you?"
His muscles tensed up again, his face was gloomy, and there was a dark fire in his eyes that stared at her, which made her shudder.
Just like a small animal seeing a carnivorous beast, her instinct told her to run away, and she did so. He just stepped back a little when he grabbed his arm.
"Brother Su...?" She licked her lips nervously.
Su Jincang's eyes became darker.
This clumsy guy touched his sensitive waist and asked him what happened with his big innocent eyes.
He originally just wanted to give her a warning, but when he saw her lilac tongue licking her lips, all his male instincts were awakened.
What is there to endure? She is his wife, isn't she?
Although he only regarded her as a pawn, there was no reason why he couldn't have some fun in the process. Once he made the decision, he moved without hesitation, pulling her into his arms, holding her tightly, lowering his head and grabbing the lips that were slightly opened in surprise.
The soft lips were as sweet as the wedding. While she was in a daze, his tongue sneaked into the soft sandalwood mouth, sucking and plundering wantonly.
Being inexperienced, she could only helplessly let him invade and possess her. She heard the wet sound of kissing in her ears, her nose was filled with his delicious scent, and her whole body felt hot.
When he ended the long kiss, she was already dizzy and could only fall softly on his chest.
"Go to bed!" His low command sounded urgent.
She obeyed the order subconsciously, stood up in panic, and climbed onto the bed.
"Take off your clothes."
"Huh?"
Although she was slow, she knew what he wanted to do by this time. It's not that she hasn't fantasized about having close contact with the Prince Charming in her mind, but she's just not mentally prepared for the moment, and his domineering commanding tone is completely different from her fantasy...
"S-shall I take it off myself?"
"Nonsense."
"But..."
The protest she wanted to say shrank back when she saw his stern face. She lowered her head and shook her hands. She began to unbutton her shirt, but her vision was blurry.
After finally taking off her shirt, she seemed to have exhausted all her strength, keeping her head down, not daring to look at him at all, but she could feel that his gaze was burning her skin like hot rays, making her feel shy and her whole body burning.

She suddenly raised her head in surprise, and he narrowed his eyes, as if to say: Do you dare to be disobedient?
She could never refuse him despite being defeated.
But she just felt so wronged and embarrassed. Her eyes were filled with tears, but she didn't dare to cry. She could only bite her lower lip until she could taste blood...
The way she dared to be angry but dared not speak out gave him a painful pleasure in his eyes. He likes to bully her and has been in love with that weird pleasure since he was a child. Now being with her brings back those memories.

His movements were not gentle at all, like a beast preying on the Ripper. Although scared and nervous as hell, she told herselfThe man who hugged her was her favorite brother Su and her husband, so she did not resist.
His hoarse voice whispered in her ear, but his commanding tone was still the same strong.
Her whole body stiffened and she looked at him in confusion.
What was pressing against her lower abdomen was a strange and hot man. His astonishing size and erection made her take a breath. She couldn't believe that a man and a woman could be combined in this way.
Su Jincang was driven by an inexplicable urgency. As soon as he touched her body, the self-control he had always been proud of suddenly collapsed.
